title: MOGATRON
tagline: Eight lightbikes, three laps: down the Helix, through the esses, over the gap above the night city and home in a blaze of light.
blurb: MOGATRON: ride Cryo Vector against seven rivals on lightbikes that stream ribbons of light. One circuit, Voltline: blast out of the Ignition Bore, drop down the banked Helix Drain as data cubes crash through its roof, thread the Splitwire Esses past rolling plasma wheels, jump the gap on the Overclock Span above the neon city, sweep round the Dynamo Drum under toppling pylons, then flat out down the Last Light Straight. Drift for boosts and hit the pads; no weapons, no pickups, just the line. Three laps, eight bikes, and a knock never ends your race.
